title: Instruction Pair (SFT)
description: Single instruction-following training example emitted by Trainforge's synthesize_training stage. One JSONL line per pair. Shapes are intentionally flat so downstream SFT trainers (Alpaca/OpenAI) can remap with a single projection.

prompt.description: The instruction a model must answer. Must not contain a verbatim span of 50+ consecutive characters from the source chunk text.

completion.description: The target completion the model should produce.

chunk_id.description: Source chunk id from imscc_chunks/chunks.jsonl (Phase 7c rename of corpus/chunks.jsonl, e.g. sample_course_chunk_00042).

lo_refs.description: Learning-outcome refs the source chunk maps to. Never empty: chunks without LO refs do not generate pairs.

content_type.description: Content-type label from the source chunk. Free-string (derived from content_type_label or chunk_type when the label is missing).

seed.description: Seed used for deterministic template selection and sampling. Same chunk + same seed -> identical pair.

decision_capture_id.description: event_id from the decision-capture log that records why this pair was synthesized. Resolves against the run's decisions JSONL.

template_id.description: Id of the prompt template used (bloom-level x content-type). Optional but useful for debugging.

provider.description: Which synthesis provider produced the pair.

question_type.$comment: 9-value canonical enum mirrored from schemas/taxonomies/question_type.json#/$defs/QuestionType. Inlined (not $ref'd) until P2.5 migrates this schema to Draft 2020-12; cross-draft $ref resolution is implementation-specific. Drift between this enum and the canonical taxonomy is a documentation bug — see plans/wave-D1-p0-fixes-2026-05-07.md § T1.2.
question_type.description: Canonical question-type discriminator consumed by the W6.B per-question-type summary and W7.A-C per-metric segmentation. Optional so legacy corpora pre-Wave-8 stay schema-valid.

promotion_status.description: GPT Feedback v2 P0c Fix 7a — training-pair promotion ladder. Optional on first land; emitter assigns 'pending' on first emit, then upgrades through candidate / validated / trainable / rejected per the TrainingPairPromotionValidator (Wave 2).

rejection_reason.description: Free-string rejection rationale. Populated only when promotion_status == 'rejected'.

observed_bloom.description: BERT-ensemble classification of the emitted prompt+completion. Null when classifier didn't run.

bloom_alignment.description: True iff observed_bloom == bloom_level. Null when observed_bloom is unset.

answer_support_score.description: Cosine similarity (or per-pair entailment score) between completion and the cited source chunk text. Null when the score wasn't computed.

rationale_richness_score.description: Heuristic semantic-richness score over the rationale string. Null when not computed.

source_chunk_id.description: Stable id of the source chunk this pair was synthesized from. Optional in general; required when promotion_status == 'trainable' (see if/then clause). Closes the source-free-generation hole at the schema layer.

per_claim_support.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.A — per-sentence NLI entailment audit of the completion against the cited chunk text. One entry per sentence the claim-support validator scored. Null when NLI deps are missing (graceful-degrade) or when the validator hasn't run on this pair yet (legacy / pre-Wave-4 corpora). Mirrors the W2.E promotion_status migration shape: optional day-1, may upgrade to required-conditional once the validator has rolled across every active corpus. Per-item shape canonicalised at pair_audit_fields.schema.json#/$defs/PerClaimSupport (W-D4).

claim_support_rate.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.A — fraction of scored sentences whose outcome was 'entailed'. Null when NLI deps are missing or the validator hasn't run on this pair.

claim_contradicted_rate.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.A — fraction of scored sentences whose outcome was 'contradicted'. Null when NLI deps are missing or the validator hasn't run on this pair.

pair_objective_alignment.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.C — per-(pair, objective_id) delivery-alignment audit emitted by PairObjectiveDeliveryValidator. One entry per learning-outcome ref the pair claims to teach / assess. Mirrors the W1.7.C Block.objectiveAlignment surface but at pair scope (NLI entailment of the objective statement against prompt+completion + Bloom-level gap + action-verb presence). Null when the validator hasn't run on this pair (legacy / pre-Wave-4 corpora) or NLI deps are missing (graceful-degrade). Mirrors the W4.A / W4.B day-1 contract: optional now, may upgrade to required-conditional once the validator has rolled across every active corpus. Per-item shape canonicalised at pair_audit_fields.schema.json#/$defs/PairObjectiveAlignment (W-D4).

pair_objective_alignment_pass_rate.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.C — fraction of pair_objective_alignment[] entries whose status == 'delivered'. Null when pair_objective_alignment is null or empty.
